_meta.descripcion: The 3 rotations compared by the app. Each rotation is a 4-year cycle with one rainfed campaign per year.
_meta.anios: Each year names a crop id from cultivos.json (sown in its first meses_siembra) or 'descanso' (fallow).
_meta.mes_siembra: Optional override of the sowing month for that year.

rotaciones.resumen: A reference rotation for Cajamarca. High water and nutrient demand, without nitrogen fixation.
Includes nitrogen-fixing faba bean and ends with forage oats for dairy livestock.
Andean lupin and vetch fix nitrogen and have estimated drought tolerance; vetch covers the soil and helps reduce erosion.
